land_pattern.notes: Body D1 4.70-4.90mm x E1 5.70-5.90mm, overall D 5.15mm x E 6.15mm, lead pitch e=1.27mm BSC. Recommended soldering footprint (from datasheet drawing dims): source/gate lead pads approx 1.0mm x 0.75mm at 1.27mm pitch; exposed drain pad (Pin 5) approx 3.2mm x 4.56mm centered on the package. Exact pad geometry read from the footprint drawing's dimension callouts (1.270, 0.750, 1.000, 0.905, 4.530, 1.530, 4.560, 0.495, 3.200, 1.330, 0.965mm); verify against the vendor land-pattern drawing before finalizing the footprint, since the numeric labels could not be matched one-to-one to specific pad edges from text extraction alone.
